sources.title: hf_food_not_food_text_classifier_with_distilbert_demo
sources.snippet: Demo to showcase a text classifier to determine if a sentence is about food or not food. DistilBERT model fine-tuned on a small synthetic dataset of 250 generated food/not_food image captions

sources.title: Food Not Food Text Classifier - a Hugging Face Space by adamNLP
sources.snippet: A text classifier to determine if a sentence is about food or not food. Fine-tuned from DistilBERT a dataset of LLM generated food/not_food image captions

sources.title: gokulan006/Food-Not-Food-Not-Classifier - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project is a text classification model built using Hugging Face's 🤗 transformers library. The model classifies textual data into two categories: 🍕 Foodand 🚫 Not Food. It utilizes a pre-trained transformer model fine-tuned on a labeled dataset for text classification.

sources.title: Food Not Food Classifier — Peter Junior Andrew
sources.snippet: A lightweight NLP model that reads any sentence and determines whether it's talking about food or not — returning a label and a confidence score. Simple premise. Real ML pipeline. "I love pizza on Friday nights" Food0.999 "The stock market dropped today" Not Food0.998 Type Binary Text Classification Model DistilBERT (fine-tuned) Accuracy 100% ...
